column1: Q1. A trader marks an article 40% above its cost price. He allows a 10% discount on the marked price and still earns a profit of ₹36. Find the cost price of the article.
Q2. An article has a marked price of ₹2240. It is sold at a discount of 20% on the marked price, but the seller still makes a profit of 12%. Find the cost price.
Q3. A sells an item to B at 20% profit. B sells it to C at 10% loss. C pays ₹594. Find A's cost price.
Q4. A trader buys an article at ₹720 and sells it at a loss equal to 25% of his cost price. At what price does he sell it?
Q5. A trader sells an article at a profit of 30%. If he had sold it for ₹60 more, he would have made a profit of 20%. Find the cost price.
Q6.A shopkeeper sells rice at a 10% profit but uses a weight that is 20% less than the actual weight. What is his total profit percentage?
